authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant AI artifacts despite strong visual appeal and lighting. Key defects include: 1) Fusion/melting at the interface between cat paws and pig backs - lack of clear contact shadows or separation indicates structural blending. 2) Texture anomaly on pigs - unnaturally smooth, airbrushed surface lacking expected coarse bristles per taxonomy. 3) Structural collapse in monkeys' lower bodies - legs are largely invisible or morphed into background/cats. The animal_pose_auditor confirmed low confidence keypoints (24.7% ratio below 0.5 threshold) particularly in hind limbs (9 low-conf), front limbs (8 low-conf), and face (4 low-conf), directly correlating with these anatomical uncertainties. While perceptual_quality_auditor found no graphics-level distortions, the biological inaccuracies and fusion artifacts substantially reduce authenticity. The fine_grained_classifier's top-3 prediction including 'computer keyboard' for cats further suggests underlying generation instability.
